name: swag_pro_printfection-mcp
description: Swag Pro (formerly Printfection) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, create_order

platform_mcp_swag_pro_printfection_api_k.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SWAG_PRO_PRINTFECTION_API_KEY
platform_mcp_swag_pro_printfection_api_k.description: Swag Pro (Printfection) API key from https://app.printfection.com/account/api_keys.php, sent as the HTTP Basic username with an empty password.

platform_mcp_swag_pro_printfection_campa.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SWAG_PRO_PRINTFECTION_CAMPAIGN_ID
platform_mcp_swag_pro_printfection_campa.description: Numeric id of the Collection campaign create_order places orders in (GET /campaigns, not mapped). Only Giveaway and Collection campaigns are supported by the API.

tools.name: me
tools.description: There is no account endpoint; the probe lists one campaign with the key (answers an array, so `account` is empty on success). Authenticated requests are hard-limited to 1000 per hour.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /items: the swag items in your account (item objects {id, name, color, product{id, name}, sizes[{id, name, short_name, stock{available}}], stock{available} (only when the item has no sizes), assets[{type, perspective, url}]}), at most 100 per response with limit/offset. `stock` is null for sized items (see raw.sizes). `query` and `category` are not accepted.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /items/:id — one item with sizes[{id, name, short_name, stock{available}}]; size ids are per item and go into create_order lineitems.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: POST /orders creates an OPEN order in the Collection campaign from the campaign_id setting. 'Orders cannot be placed explicitly through the API': Collection orders are gathered and placed (approved, and billed) from within the Swag Pro account. `shipping_address` is ship_to {name, address, address2, company, city, state, zip, country, email, phone}; `items` are lineitems [{item_id, size_id (0 for unsized items), quantity}] (several lineitems only on Collection campaigns). `shipping_option` is not sent.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /orders/:id — status is one of open, received, approved, processed, shipped, completed (cancelled after DELETE); totals and shipments come from the order manifest {subtotal, tax, shipping, fulfillment, total, shipments[{carrier, method, tracking_numbers[]}]}.

tools.name: track
tools.description: The order's manifest.shipments [{carrier, method, tracking_numbers[], created_at}] as events (one per shipment); empty until the order ships. There is no separate tracking endpoint.
